{{Infobox Location |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= File:BotW Illusory Realm.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW |other= |inhab= |items= |season= |temperature= |theme= |related= }} The {{Term/Store|Illusory Realm|Illusory Realms|Series, BotW}} is a location in {{BotW}}. It is exclusive to {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] pack. ==Features and Overview== {{Quests|width=38.7rem| {{BotW Quest |name= EX Champion Daruk's Song |type= Main Quest |giver= [[Monk|???]] |location= [[Eldin Mountains]] }} {{BotW Quest |name= EX Champion Mipha's Song |type= Main Quest |giver= [[Monk|???]] |location= [[Ja'Abu Ridge]] }} {{BotW Quest |name= EX Champion Revali's Song |type= Main Quest |giver= [[Monk|???]] |location= [[Strock Lake]] }} {{BotW Quest |name= EX Champion Urbosa's Song |type= Main Quest |giver= [[Monk|???]] |location= [[East Gerudo Mesa]] }} {{BotW Quest |name= EX The Champions' Ballad |type= Main Quest |giver= [[Zelda]] |location= [[Shrine of Resurrection]] }} }} The Illusory Realm is a world created from [[Link]]'s memories and fears. It is marked by a hazy cloud which may impede Link's vision. It is visited four times during the four [[Main Quest]]s comprising "[[EX The Champions' Ballad]]", after completing their three respective [[Shrine of a Champion|Shrines of Champions]] and returning to the corresponding [[Divine Beast]]. [[Monk Maz Koshia]] will greet Link and, in exchange for the three emblems from the Shrines, allow him to face the trial within his memories. Maz Koshia warns him not to underestimate or dismiss it as merely imaginary, before Link is transported to the Illusory Realm. Upon appearing in the Illusory Realm, Link will be in the interior of the Divine Beast, where he must once again battle a manifestation of the [[Phantom Ganon]] that had dwelt within, created from his fears. The four battles in the Illusory Realm are: *"[[EX Champion Mipha's Song]]", battling [[Waterblight Ganon]] in a replica of [[Divine Beast Vah Ruta]]; *"[[EX Champion Revali's Song]]", battling [[Windblight Ganon]] in a replica of [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]]; *"[[EX Champion Daruk's Song]]", battling [[Fireblight Ganon]] in a replica of [[Divine Beast Vah Rudania]]; *"[[EX Champion Urbosa's Song]]", battling [[Thunderblight Ganon]] in a replica of [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris]]. Each battle provides Link with a different pre-determined set of [[Weapon]]s, [[Armor]], and [[Food]]. After three attempts, Link will also receive a [[Fairy]], and after six, he will receive additional [[Meal]]s and/or [[Elixir]]s. After this, the Champion's [[Spirit]] will grant Link an upgraded version of their signature ability, and their Main Quest branch of "EX The Champions' Ballad" will be completed. After Link has completed the corresponding Quest, he can return to the Divine Beast and face the challenge once again. Successfully repeating it will result in unique dialogue from the Champion's Spirit. These rematches also still count towards the extra items appearing in Link's Inventory, in addition to continuing after a [[Game Over]].
